lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਰਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape kaasat aap har piaaraa vich kaasat agan rakhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Lord Himself is the firewood, and He Himself keeps the fire within the wood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਭੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape hee aap varatadaa piaaraa bhai agan na sakai jalaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Lord Himself, all by Himself, permeates them, and because of the Fear of God, the fire cannot burn the wood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਾਹ ਲੈਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape maar jeevaaidaa piaaraa saah laide sabh lavaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself kills and revives; all draw the breath of life, given by Him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape taan deebaan hai piaaraa aape kaarai laaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself is power and presence; He Himself engages us in our work.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਲੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu aap chalaae tiu chaleeai piaare jiu har prabh mere bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: As the Beloved makes me walk, I walk, as it pleases my Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤੀ ਜੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aape ja(n)tee ja(n)t hai piaaraa jan naanak vajahi vajaaiaa ||4||4||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself is the musician, and the musical instrument; servant Nanak vibrates His vibration. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape srisat upaaidaa piaaraa kar sooraj cha(n)d chaanaan ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself created the Universe; He made the light of the sun and the moon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap nitaaniaa taan hai piaaraa aap nimaaniaa maan ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself is the power of the powerless; He Himself is the honor of the dishonored.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aap daiaa kar rakhadaa piaaraa aape sughaR sujaan ||1||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself grants His Grace and protects us; He Himself is wise and all-knowing. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man jap raam naam neesaan ||
lines.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and receive His Insignia.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil dhiaai too har har bahuR na aavan jaan || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har; you shall not have to come and go in reincarnation again. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape hee gun varatadaa piaaraa aape hee paravaan ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself pervades His Glorious Praises, and He Himself approves them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhas karaaidaa piaaraa aape sach neesaan ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself grants His forgiveness, and He Himself bestows the Insignia of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape hukam varatadaa piaaraa aape hee phuramaan ||2||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself obeys His Will, and He Himself issues His Command. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape bhagat bha(n)daar hai piaaraa aape devai daan ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself is the treasure of devotion; He Himself gives His gifts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sev karaaidaa piaaraa aap divaavai maan ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself commits some to His service, and He Himself blesses them with honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape taaRee laaidaa piaaraa aape gunee nidhaan ||3||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself is absorbed in Samaadhi; He Himself is the treasure of excellence. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਧਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape vadaa aap hai piaaraa aape hee paradhaan ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself is the greatest; He Himself is supreme.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਤੁਲੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape keemat paaidaa piaaraa aape tul paravaan ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself appraises the value; He Himself is the scale, and the weights.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੁਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aape atul tulaaidaa piaaraa jan naanak sad kurabaan ||4||5||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself is unweighable - He weighs Himself; servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sevaa laaidaa piaaraa aape bhagat umaahaa ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself commits some to His service; He Himself blesses them with the joy of devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape gun gaavaaidaa piaaraa aape sabad samaahaa ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself causes us to sing His Glorious Praises; He Himself is absorbed in the Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape lekhan aap likhaaree aape lekh likhaahaa ||1||
lines.translation: He Himself is the pen, and He Himself is the scribe; He Himself inscribes His inscription. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man jap raam naam omaahaa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, joyfully chant the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin anad hovai vadabhaagee lai gur poorai har laahaa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those very fortunate ones are in ecstasy night and day; through the Perfect Guru, they obtain the profit of the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੋਪੀ ਕਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਬਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਗਊ ਚਰਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape gopee kaan hai piaaraa ban aape gaoo charaahaa ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself is the milk-maid and Krishna; He Himself herds the cows in the woods.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਵਲ ਸੁੰਦਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੰਸੁ ਵਜਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape saaval su(n)daraa piaaraa aape va(n)s vajaahaa ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself is the blue-skinned, handsome one; He Himself plays on His flute.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਵਲੀਆਪੀੜੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਰਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਰੂਪਿ ਪਚਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kuvaleeaapeeR aap maraaidaa piaaraa kar baalak roop pachaahaa ||2||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself took the form of a child, and destroyed Kuwalia-peer, the mad elephant. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਖਾੜਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਚੋਜਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap akhaaRaa paaidaa piaaraa kar vekhai aap chojaahaa ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself sets the stage; He performs the plays, and He Himself watches them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਰੂਪ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਚੰਡੂਰੁ ਕੰਸੁ ਕੇਸੁ ਮਾਰਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar baalak roop upaaidaa piaaraa cha(n)door ka(n)s kes maaraahaa ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself assumed the form of the child, and killed the demons Chandoor, Kansa and Kaysee.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਬਲੁ ਭੰਨੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾਹਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape hee bal aap hai piaaraa bal bha(n)nai moorakh mugadhaahaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself, by Himself, is the embodiment of power; He shatters the power of the fools and idiots. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹਥਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh aape jagat upaaidaa piaaraa vas aape jugat hathaahaa ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Himself created the whole world. In His hands He holds the power of the ages.
